title: NavVis 3D Integration
outcome: Integrate NavVis IVION SDK with three-mode asset positioning (position-asset, reposition-asset, add-asset) in Vuex state.
rationale: Immersive 3D facility navigation, accurate asset positioning, three-mode workflows, coordinate integration with 2D maps.

risk.acceptance: Large component (2793 lines), NavVis SDK dependency, complex state, but necessary for 3D features.
